title: Drive
empty: Your Drive holds files you and your agent both read and change, from any workspace. Upload a file to start.
emptyFolder: This folder is empty. Drop files here or upload them.

edit.saveFailed: Could not save the file. Your text is still here.
edit.gone: This file was moved or deleted while you were editing. Your text is still here; copy it before you leave.
edit.changedUnder: {{who}} changed this file while you were editing. Your changes are kept.
edit.leaveBody: Your changes to this file have not been saved.

conflict.title: Not saved.
conflict.body: {{who}} changed this file after you started editing. Keep your version, take theirs, or compare the two.

memo.marked: Marked {{name}} as a memo. Every version is kept from now on.
memo.unmarked: {{name}} is no longer a memo. Its record is kept.

dialog.markBody: A memo keeps every version, with who made it and why.
dialog.editBody: Changes to the status and tickers go in the memo's record.
dialog.unmarkBody: Its versions and record are kept. From its next save it keeps only the copy from before that save, as other files do.
dialog.tooManyTickers: A memo takes at most {{max}} tickers.

versions.restoreHint: Saves this content as a new version.

undo.kept_one: The copy before is kept {{count}} more day
undo.kept_other: The copy before is kept {{count}} more days
undo.done: Put back {{name}} as it was before its last save
undo.nothing: There is no earlier copy to go back to.

record.markedStatus: {{who}} marked it as a memo with status {{status}}
record.markedStatusPinned: {{who}} marked it as a memo with status {{status}}, pinning v{{seq}}
record.wasMemo: This file was a memo. Its record is kept; saves since keep only the copy from before the last one.
record.clearConfirm_one: {{count}} earlier version goes for good, freeing {{size}}. The current version stays, and the record will show that it was cleared.
record.clearConfirm_other: {{count}} earlier versions go for good, freeing {{size}}. The current version stays, and the record will show that they were cleared.
record.clearConfirmFinal_one: {{count}} earlier version goes for good, freeing {{size}}. The current version and the final (v{{seq}}) stay, and the record will show that it was cleared.
record.clearConfirmFinal_other: {{count}} earlier versions go for good, freeing {{size}}. The current version and the final (v{{seq}}) stay, and the record will show that they were cleared.
record.clearFailed: Could not clear the earlier versions

changes.first: Version {{seq}} is the first: all of it is new.
changes.truncated: Only the start of the text could be read, so the comparison stops there.
changes.notText: Changes are shown for text, Word and PDF memos. Open a version from the record to see it.
changes.stillReading: Still reading the text of version {{seq}}. Try again in a moment.
changes.tooLarge: Version {{seq}} is too large to read its text.
changes.empty: No text could be read out of version {{seq}}.
changes.failed: Reading the text of version {{seq}} failed.

authors.label: {{who}} · {{when}}
authors.title: Version {{seq}}, {{when}}. Open its changes.
authors.notText: Who wrote what is shown for text memos only.
authors.notMemo: Who wrote what is shown for memos only.
authors.busy: Still working out who wrote what. Try again in a moment.

memos.title: Memos
memos.none: No memos yet. Mark any file as a memo from its menu.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description_one: Deleted files stay here for {{count}} day, then are removed for good.
trash.description_other: Deleted files stay here for {{count}} days, then are removed for good.
trash.descriptionHolding_one: Deleted files stay here for {{count}} day, then are removed for good. The trash holds {{size}}, which does not count toward your Drive's space. If it grows past that space, the oldest items go early.
trash.descriptionHolding_other: Deleted files stay here for {{count}} days, then are removed for good. The trash holds {{size}}, which does not count toward your Drive's space. If it grows past that space, the oldest items go early.
trash.restoredAs: Restored {{name}} as {{as}}, since the name was taken
trash.purgeConfirm: Delete {{name}} for good? This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} item for good? This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} items for good? This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirmAll: Delete everything in the trash for good? This cannot be undone.
trash.none_one: The trash is empty. Deleted files wait here for {{count}} day.
trash.none_other: The trash is empty. Deleted files wait here for {{count}} days.
trash.andMore_one: with {{count}} more deleted at the same time
trash.andMore_other: with {{count}} more deleted at the same time
trash.newestOnly: Showing the newest {{count}}. Restore or delete some to see the rest.

newFolder.description: Make a folder in the one you are viewing.

rename.description: A memo keeps its record under the new name.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.description: Pick the folder to move it into.

upload.title: Uploads
upload.full: Your Drive is full. Delete files to make room.
upload.tooMany: Your Drive holds as many files as it can. Delete some or empty the trash.
upload.interrupted: The upload stopped. Check your connection, then retry to pick up where it left off.
upload.tooManyUploads: Too many uploads are open at once. Retry when one has finished.
upload.mismatch: The file changed while it was uploading. Retry to send it again.
upload.elsewhereCount_one: {{count}} upload going on in another tab
upload.elsewhereCount_other: {{count}} uploads going on in another tab
upload.notSameFile: {{chosen}} is not the file this upload was sent from. Choose {{name}} ({{size}}), unchanged since the upload began.
upload.replacesUnkept: Replaces the current {{name}}, which is not kept: files this large keep no earlier versions.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load this. Check your connection and try again.
errors.gone: It is no longer there. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.trashFailed: Could not move it to trash
errors.purgeFailed: Could not delete it for good
errors.missing: {{name}} is not in your Drive. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.busy: The server is busy and could not save {{name}}. Try again in a moment.
errors.badName: The Drive cannot use the name {{name}}.
errors.noRoomFile: {{name}} needs {{size}}, and only {{left}} of your {{max}} is free. Delete files to make room.
errors.noRoom: {{name}} does not fit: only {{left}} of your {{max}} is free. Delete files to make room.
errors.changed: {{name}} changed since you last looked. Look at it again, then try once more.
errors.notMemo: {{name}} is not a memo any more.
